[SWS_WdgM_00232]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09232
⌈When this service is called, the Watchdog Manager shall set the trigger condition for
all configured Watchdog Drivers to 0 (zero).⌋
Thereby, the hardware watchdogs will cause an external hardware reset.
